description: DAEDALUS/PLINY WP-7 (Arc 61 recon, pre-existing, OUT OF SCOPE for arc-61). substrate/skills/decision-surface/ exists on disk and is rendered into the Stoa app's LIEUTENANT slot via gen-data discoverSkillFiles (which reads ALL skills/<name>/ dirs), but is NOT listed in install.sh SKILL_NAMES — so it does NOT deploy to consumer .claude/skills/ via install.sh's skill loop. INCONSISTENCY: app shows it, install.sh doesn't ship it. PLAN: investigate whether this is INTENTIONAL (app-only display skill, not meant for consumer deploy) or a GAP (should be in SKILL_NAMES). If gap -> add to SKILL_NAMES + redeploy. If intentional -> document why (and consider whether gen-data should filter it from the LIEUTENANT slot for parity). Anchor: Arc-61 design-rev1.md WP-7. Pre-existing, not arc-61-caused.
